title: An SGP4-XP element set (ephemeris type 4) is refused, never propagated as SGP4; its type-0 twin propagates

checks.description: Set 20453 with EPHEMERIS_TYPE 4 (an SGP4-XP element set) as TLE, OMM CSV, JSON, XML and KVN, and a KVN also saying MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY = SGP4-XP (the corpus's spelling, synthetic), each through the propagate hook: a position at any step fails the file, since SGP4 propagates such a set to positions that look right and are not, and so do error codes stamped beside positions; a refusal passes (a raise, Unsupported for the type-4 set alone, a refusal from parse while its twin is read, or an SGP4 error code at every step with no position, as Vallado's C++ answers). An adapter that sets propagates_sgp4_xp = True is not graded on it (the owner's ruling, 2026-11-01; D-409).

Each type-4 file's twin, the same values with EPHEMERIS_TYPE 0, through the same hook: it must propagate within 2e-7 km and km/s of the twins' reference vectors (vectors/propagation-twins.json, D-406), its codes exact, so a hook that refuses every set fails here, and so does Unsupported for the twin alone (D-205, D-280); a format unsupported for both files is skipped and named (D-409).

provides: one near-earth set with a non-zero BSTAR, type 4 and type 0, in TLE and the four OMM formats, six times each
gaps: one set; SGP4-XP itself is not graded: gpconf has no SGP4-XP reference, and an adapter that claims it is not graded on the type-4 files
ephemeris types 1 to 3 out of scope for 0.9.0 (the owner's ruling)
an adapter's claim of SGP4-XP is taken as given: a library that claims it and propagates as SGP4 is not caught
WGS-72 and opsmode 'i' only for the twins
